column1: The capacity of the Senanayaka Samudraya has reached to its peak at 4.00 pm today (770,000
ac.ft.). As such there is a high possibility of increasing the spillway discharge starting evening today.
Therefore, the public and the vehicle drivers who are running in the downstream areas of the Gal
Oya are kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by floods.
Specially the people who are living nearby the low line areas of Polwaththa, Pahalalanda,
Irakkamam, Akkaraipattu, Addalachchenai, Alayadiwembu, Sammanthurai, Karthiv,
Ninthavur, Sainthamarudu, Kalmunai and South Eastern University Area at Oluvil and vehicle
drivers running through those areas should be vigilant
